module grading.letters
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades and tally them.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade from A (best) to F (failing).
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: How many students received each letter grade.
  has a_count: Integer
  has b_count: Integer
  has c_count: Integer
  has d_count: Integer
  has f_count: Integer
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public function letter_grade(score: Integer)
  returns Grade
  purpose: Map one score to a letter using the 90, 80, 70 and 60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  example: letter_grade(95) is A
  example: letter_grade(90) is A
  example: letter_grade(89) is B
  example: letter_grade(75) is C
  example: letter_grade(60) is D
  example: letter_grade(59) is F

  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end
end

public function letter_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Grade
  purpose: Convert every score in the list to its letter grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grade
  example: letter_grades([95, 82, 71, 64, 12]) is [A, B, C, D, F]
  example: letter_grades([]) is []

  return for each score in scores collect letter_grade(score)
end

public function grade_counts(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students earned each letter grade.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grade
  example: grade_counts([95, 91, 85, 40]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 1, c_count: 0, d_count: 0, f_count: 1)
  example: grade_counts([]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 0, b_count: 0, c_count: 0, d_count: 0, f_count: 0)

  let a_total be for each score in scores where letter_grade(score) is A count
  let b_total be for each score in scores where letter_grade(score) is B count
  let c_total be for each score in scores where letter_grade(score) is C count
  let d_total be for each score in scores where letter_grade(score) is D count
  let f_total be for each score in scores where letter_grade(score) is F count
  return GradeCounts(a_count: a_total, b_count: b_total, c_count: c_total, d_count: d_total, f_count: f_total)
end

module grading.letters
  purpose: Turn percentage scores into letter grades and tally how many students earned each grade.

public type Score is Integer where value is at least 0 and value is at most 100
  purpose: A percentage score from 0 to 100 inclusive.

public function letter_for(score: Score)
  returns Text
  purpose: Convert one score to a letter grade using the 90, 80, 70 and 60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grades
  example: letter_for(Score(95)) is "A"
  example: letter_for(Score(90)) is "A"
  example: letter_for(Score(89)) is "B"
  example: letter_for(Score(75)) is "C"
  example: letter_for(Score(60)) is "D"
  example: letter_for(Score(59)) is "F"

  if score is at least 90 then
    return "A"
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return "B"
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return "C"
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return "D"
  otherwise
    return "F"
  end
end

public function letter_grades(scores: List of Score)
  returns List of Text
  purpose: Convert every score in the list to its letter grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_for
  example: letter_grades([Score(95), Score(82), Score(40)]) is ["A", "B", "F"]

  return for each score in scores collect letter_for(score)
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Score)
  returns Map of Text to Integer
  purpose: Count how many students earned each letter grade; every grade from A to F is present, with zero when nobody earned it.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: letter_for
  example: count_grades([Score(95), Score(91), Score(72), Score(10)]) is {"A": 2, "B": 0, "C": 1, "D": 0, "F": 1}

  let mutable counts be {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0, "D": 0, "F": 0}
  for each score in scores
    let letter be letter_for(score)
    let current be counts.get(letter) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: letter, value: current + 1)
  end
  return counts
end

  tags: grading
  example: letter_grade(Score(95)) is A

  example: letter_grade(Score(89)) is B
  example: letter_grade(Score(70)) is C
  example: letter_grade(Score(60)) is D
  example: letter_grade(Score(59)) is F

  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end

public function letter_grades(scores: List of Score)
  returns List of Grade
  purpose: Convert every score to its letter grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading

  example: letter_grades([Score(95), Score(72), Score(40)]) is [A, C, F]

  return for each score in scores collect letter_grade(score)
end

public function grade_counts(scores: List of Score)
  returns Map of Grade to Integer
  purpose: Count how many students received each grade; every grade is present, with 0 when nobody got it.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: letter_grades
  example: grade_counts([Score(95), Score(91), Score(55)]) is {A: 2, B: 0, C: 0, D: 0, F: 1}

  let grades be letter_grades(scores)
  let a_count be for each grade in grades where grade is A count
  let b_count be for each grade in grades where grade is B count
  let c_count be for each grade in grades where grade is C count
  let d_count be for each grade in grades where grade is D count
  let f_count be for each grade in grades where grade is F count
  return {A: a_count, B: b_count, C: c_count, D: d_count, F: f_count}
end

test "cut-offs are inclusive"
  check letter_grade(Score(80)) is B
  check letter_grade(Score(100)) is A
  check letter_grade(Score(0)) is F
end

test "counts cover every grade"
  let counts be grade_counts([Score(85), Score(86), Score(61)])
  check counts.get(B) is 2
  check counts.get(D) is 1

module school.grades
  purpose: Turn numeric scores into letter grades and count how many students earned each grade.

public type Score is Integer where value is at least 0 and value is at most 100
  purpose: A percentage score from 0 to 100.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade from A (best) to F (failing).
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: How many students received each letter grade.
  has a_count: Integer
  has b_count: Integer
  has c_count: Integer
  has d_count: Integer
  has f_count: Integer
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public function letter_for(score: Score)
  returns Grade
  purpose: Give the letter grade for one score using the 90, 80, 70 and 60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grades
  example: letter_for(Score(95)) is A
  example: letter_for(Score(90)) is A
  example: letter_for(Score(89)) is B
  example: letter_for(Score(70)) is C
  example: letter_for(Score(65)) is D
  example: letter_for(Score(12)) is F

  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end
end

public function letter_grades(scores: List of Score)
  returns List of Grade
  purpose: Give the letter grade for every score, keeping the order of the list.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_for
  example: letter_grades([Score(95), Score(55)]) is [A, F]
  example: letter_grades([]) is []

  return for each score in scores collect letter_for(score)
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Score)
  returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: letter_grades
  example: count_grades([Score(95), Score(91), Score(42)]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 0, c_count: 0, d_count: 0, f_count: 1)
  example: count_grades([]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 0, b_count: 0, c_count: 0, d_count: 0, f_count: 0)

  let mutable a_total be 0
  let mutable b_total be 0
  let mutable c_total be 0
  let mutable d_total be 0
  let mutable f_total be 0
  for each grade in letter_grades(scores)
    match grade
      when A then set a_total to a_total + 1
      when B then set b_total to b_total + 1
      when C then set c_total to c_total + 1
      when D then set d_total to d_total + 1
      when F then set f_total to f_total + 1
    end
  end
  return GradeCounts(a_count: a_total, b_count: b_total, c_count: c_total, d_count: d_total, f_count: f_total)
end

test "cut-offs are inclusive"
  check letter_for(Score(80)) is B
  check letter_for(Score(60)) is D
  check letter_for(Score(59)) is F
end

test "counts add up to the number of students"
  let counts be count_grades([Score(100), Score(85), Score(72), Score(61), Score(0), Score(88)])
  check counts.a_count is 1
  check counts.b_count is 2
  check counts.c_count is 1
  check counts.d_count is 1
  check counts.f_count is 1
end
